sources.title: GitHub - doguilmak/Drone-Detection-YOLOv11x: Real-time drone detection ...
sources.snippet: After training, the YOLOv11x model was used for real-time detection and tracking of drones in video streams. The tracking module integrates YOLO detection outputs with a multi-object tracking (MOT) algorithm, such as ByteTrack or DeepSORT, to maintain object identities across frames, even under partial occlusion or rapid movement.
